scope: Follow-up source reconnaissance for RECON-02 Home Trade and RECON-03 Khandwala / DSQ Biotech. This is not a sample decision, legal conclusion, audit, or completed first-disclosure search.

records.subject: Home Trade Ltd. trading and related broker proceedings

observations.locator: Official SEBI press-release page, title/date block and body
observations.date_type: SEBI page date shown; public-time verification pending
observations.observation: The page describes an order against M's Securities concerning HTL and says the order was passed on 14 September 2006. The page and order dates are kept separate.
observations.anchor: Order in the matter of M/s. Home Trade Ltd.

observations.locator: PDF page 2, paragraphs 1.4-1.5; PDF pages 12-13 for findings and order
observations.date_type: No public posting date in captured PDF
observations.observation: The order describes alleged circular trading and price manipulation in HTL, and broker transactions from 1999 through 2001. It ultimately states that evidence was insufficient to find a FUTP violation by this broker; the one-month suspension concerned the broker's registration.
observations.anchor: no sufficient evidence to suggest that the Broker had violated the provisions of FUTP Regulations

observations.locator: Official SEBI HTML order, sections 1.2, 1.5-1.6, 2.2, 3.5-4.0 and signature block
observations.date_type: Signature date only; public date not shown
observations.observation: The order describes allegations of circular trading, HTL listing and price history, and one broker's client trades in April-December 2001. Its final censure is for KYC and diligence failures. It is a separate broker proceeding.
observations.anchor: The broker had actively traded in the scrip of HTL and resorted to circular trading

records.assessment: These are relevant pre-2011 public-source leads about HTL trading, but they do not by themselves prove that a particular RECON-02 episode or claim was disclosed. Keep respondent, transaction, allegation, finding and episode scope distinct.

records.subject: DSQ Biotech / Khandwala-related trading and linked proceedings

observations.locator: Official SEBI press-release page, title/date block and body
observations.date_type: SEBI page date shown; public-time verification pending
observations.observation: The page concerns a CSFB order in DSQ Biotech and says the broker was advised to be careful. The page header, body dateline and order date differ.

observations.locator: Official SEBI HTML order, sections 1.1-1.3 and 3.1-3.4
observations.date_type: Signature date only; public date not shown in captured order
observations.observation: The order covers DSQ Biotech trading from December 1999 to March 2001, including synchronized trades. It says prior SEBI proceedings addressed the same period and related DSQ Biotech facts; those 2002 and 2003 orders are still retrieval leads.
observations.anchor: the same scrip/scrips, the same set of facts in the same referal period

observations.locator: Official SEBI enforcement order page, title/date block
observations.date_type: SEBI order page date shown; public-time verification pending
observations.observation: The official order landing page identifies the same DSQ Biotech investigation and reports the same 1999-2001 period as the captured order text. Its displayed date matches the order signature date; that does not independently verify first online availability.

observations.locator: Official SEBI press-release page, date block and body
observations.date_type: SEBI page date shown; public-time verification pending
observations.observation: This same-issuer release concerns earlier proceedings; PRE-06 specifies DSQ Biotech investigation windows in 1994-1996. Retain as a different-period control, not proof for a 1999-2001 episode.

observations.locator: Official SEBI HTML order, sections 1.1-1.3 and signature block
observations.date_type: Signature date only; public date not shown in captured order
observations.observation: The BKG order concerns DSQ Biotech activity in June-December 1994 and June 1995-March 1996, with a different broker respondent. Same issuer name alone is not an episode link.
observations.anchor: during the period June 1994 to December 1994

observations.locator: PDF page 2, paragraph 3(c)-(d); PDF page 11, signature block
observations.date_type: Signature date only; public date not shown in captured PDF
observations.observation: A PPTL summons-compliance order recites investigation observations of Khandwala Securities' DSQ Biotech trades, including 35 cross-deals from 21 February to 22 March 2000. The penalty is against PPTL for failing to provide information; it is not a Khandwala sanction.
observations.anchor: These deals were executed by the Khandwala Securities Ltd. during the period February 21, 2000 to March 22, 2000.

observations.locator: PDF pages 1-3, 18 and 39; PDF page 48 signature block
observations.date_type: Signature date only; public date not shown in captured PDF
observations.observation: A company/group order covers the December 1999-January 2001 investigation and identifies Khandwala Securities transactions. It is evidence in a separate company/group proceeding, not a Khandwala disposition.
observations.anchor: another 1,99,922 shares were matched with Khandwala Securities Ltd.

records.assessment: The records establish substantial earlier DSQ-related disclosures and make pre-2011 disclosure a strong eligibility concern. They do not settle the earliest episode-specific public disclosure. PRE-04 itself refers to earlier 2002 and 2003 SEBI orders concerning the same investigation period; retrieve those orders and compare their claims, public dates and party scope before assigning any date.

unresolved_leads.lead: The 2015 Home Trade order reports SEBI website SCNs dated 22 January 2008 and 18 January 2009 and a 16 February 2006 order concerning seven directors.
unresolved_leads.next_action: Locate the original notices and order; identify the specific episode facts disclosed and the public date of each source.

unresolved_leads.lead: The 2006 CSFB order references a 13 June 2002 suspension order and an 11 December 2003 order covering related DSQ Biotech facts and the same investigation period.
unresolved_leads.next_action: Locate both original orders; compare their DSQ-specific passages and public dates with the 2007 PPTL and 2015 Khandwala records.

limitations: Capture timestamps are retrieval times, not publication dates.
Order signature dates and SEBI page dates remain separately recorded.
HTML text has no stable page locator; inspect the original official page.
PDF page numbers are PDF positions and may differ from printed labels.
Related issuer, broker, client, matter and episode relationships require human review.
No reviewer identity, screening decision, workbook value or audit credit was added.
